full_page.content:
1949, July 14
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
July 14, 1949
7/14/49 Mrs. Winifred O'Donnell Hermanville, Texas
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
Blessed be God in all and Each of His ways.
Dear Mrs. O'Donnell: God bless you and guide you - always in His grace and holy, happy fear. I hope you keep from worrying over there in that promising land. I tried Saturday and Sunday to reach you and Joseph by "long-distance" but had mislaid Raymondville and consequently tried "Hargill in vain. However, I did get Joe. Monday evening after his arrival home that a.m. He felt "kinda" down that he had to come back alone, but seemingly it must have been about the best thing to do under circumstances.
After all, if we only look around us and think of the fearful conditions of society in very many places throughout "civilization", how grateful we ought to be that we have things comparatively so outstandingly fortunate.
The more I study on the "priz-contest" the clearer does this come to me. I sometimes think too: "How fortunate was poor dear Fr. Maurice Joachim, whom we burried in January after more than 81 years of "warfare," crowned by a peaceful, happy transit to eternity.
Glory and thanks be to God. ..... When I can thank even now for ptomane -trouble starting in Milwakkee, how much more will we bless God's providence for the disapointments of this vestibule to eternity when we get to Heaven ... . and eternally thereafter!
Fr. Solarus.
One badge for Joe .- to cheer him! +
